title: 1. The Notice to Appear

panels.caption: Panel 1 — Beginning: The Client Arrives
panels.sceneDescription: Escritório de advocacia. Lucas entra apressado segurando uma carta oficial do DHS.

panels.caption: Panel 2 — Middle: Reviewing the Deadline
panels.sceneDescription: A advogada analisa o documento e encontra a data da audiência na corte de imigração.

panels.caption: Panel 3 — End: Strategy for the Waiver
panels.sceneDescription: Eles definem a linha de defesa reunindo provas médicas e vínculos familiares.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Lucas walked into the law office holding an official envelope. His hands were shaking because he had overstayed his visa last year.

segments.speaker: Lucas
segments.text: Counsel, I received this Notice to Appear yesterday. Does this mean I will be deported immediately?

segments.speaker: Attorney Elena
segments.text: Take a deep breath. A hearing is only the beginning of the process, and you may qualify for a waiver if we build a strong case.

overstayed.note: Passar da data autorizada no visto.

counsel.note: Forma respeitosa de chamar o advogado.

notice.note: Em 'Notice to Appear', é a citação para comparecer à corte.

hearing.note: Sessão perante o juiz de imigração.

qualify.note: Ter direito legal a um benefício.

waiver.note: Pedido para afastar uma causa de inadmissibilidade.

strong.note: Em 'strong case', tese bem embasada em provas.

quiz.question: What does 'Notice to Appear' mean in this story?
options: An official summons to immigration court

quiz.question: Why does Attorney Elena mention a 'waiver'?
options: To ask for legal forgiveness of an inadmissibility ground

writingPrompt: Escreva 2 frases em inglês tranquilizando um cliente após receber uma Notice to Appear, usando 'hearing' e 'waiver'.
modelAnswer: Do not panic about the hearing date. We will gather evidence to prove you qualify for a waiver.

title: 2. The Motion to Suppress

panels.caption: Panel 1 — The Traffic Stop
panels.sceneDescription: Rodovia à noite. A viatura policial aborda o veículo sem mandado nem causa provável.

panels.caption: Panel 2 — Inside the Courtroom
panels.sceneDescription: A defesa apresenta o vídeo da câmera corporal apontando a busca ilegal.

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: During the night stop, the officer searched the trunk without a warrant or probable cause.

segments.speaker: Defense Attorney
segments.text: Your Honor, we filed a motion to suppress because the search violated our client's constitutional rights.

segments.speaker: Judge Carter
segments.text: The bodycam footage is clear. The evidence is inadmissible and the motion is granted.

probable.note: Em 'probable cause', justa causa / fundadas razões.

filed.note: Ato de apresentar petição nos autos.

motion.note: Em 'motion to suppress', pedido de desentranhamento de prova ilícita.

inadmissible.note: Prova que não pode ser usada no julgamento.

quiz.question: Why did the judge grant the motion to suppress?
options: The officer had no warrant or probable cause

writingPrompt: Explique em 2 frases em inglês por que uma prova obtida sem mandado pode ser excluída, usando 'warrant' e 'inadmissible'.
modelAnswer: The officer searched the car without a warrant or probable cause. Therefore, the evidence is inadmissible in court.
